verdict.rationale: The first-party README says Reader can auto-caption images that lack an `alt` tag using a vision-language model. Captions are formatted as `![Image [idx]: [VLM_caption]](img_URL)` and are explicitly meant to give a downstream text-only LLM enough hints to reason about visual content. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of caption quality, and documentation of how captioning is enabled or configured (e.g., the specific header or option) and how images that already have alt text are handled.
